name: playwright-e2e
description: Production-grade Playwright E2E testing against real public websites — demonstrating QA best practices.

scripts.test:bdd: npx bddgen -c playwright.bdd.config.ts && npx playwright test --config=playwright.bdd.config.ts
scripts.test:bdd:headed: npx bddgen -c playwright.bdd.config.ts && npx playwright test --config=playwright.bdd.config.ts --headed
scripts.report:allure: npx allure generate allure-results --clean && npx allure open allure-report
